explication: PlayCover is a macOS app for running iOS apps and games on Apple Silicon. The main workflow is to import an IPA, prepare and wrap it for macOS, then launch it from the app library; users can also browse configured app sources and download apps. Custom keyboard and controller-style touch mapping is a major product capability, alongside per-app configuration. The tree and sampled excerpts support the install, source-management, and launch paths shown; some UI and keymapping wiring is inferred only at subsystem level, so uncertain calls are omitted.
